notes: Conditional keyboard reset — no stacking change when window is unfocused: — `blur()`+`focus()` was the only proven GLib handler fix, but `blur()` generates X11 FocusOut which lowers the window on this WM. Fix: skip `blur()` when the window doesn't already have focus — `focus()` alone generates FocusIn (re-registering GLib handlers) without any stacking change. Only applies `blur()`+`focus()` when the window is focused (user is actively using it), which is a necessary tradeoff since `XSetInputFocus` is a no-op on windows that already have focus. | Keyboard reset after batch operations: — refactored keyboard reset into a shared function used by both the `window:reset-keyboard` IPC handler and the `db:batch` IPC handler, ensuring consistent behavior and avoiding code duplication.
